context: A retired uncle and an aunt reminisce together
purpose: Teach: あがっ/だす/云う/反面/誇る/著しく/僅か/満たす

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: 古いアルバムを開いたら、当時の笑い声が耳の奥からあがってくる気がするよ。
lines.en: When I open the old album, I feel the laughter of those days rising up from deep in my ears.
lines.style: Warm reflective tone, slow pacing with a touch of nostalgia.

lines.speaker: naoko_aunt
lines.jp: 本当に。子供たちが庭を駆けだすあの光景、昨日のことみたいね。
lines.en: Truly. That scene of the children starting to run through the garden feels like yesterday.
lines.style: Soft feminine voice, gentle sigh, fond memories surfacing naturally.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: 云うまでもなく、あの頃は皆若かった。近所に誇るほど賑やかな家だったな。
lines.en: Needless to say, everyone was young back then. It was a house lively enough to be proud of in the neighborhood.
lines.style: Elder masculine pride, deliberate pacing with quiet conviction.

lines.speaker: naoko_aunt
lines.jp: 賑やかで楽しい反面、苦労も多かったでしょう、あなた。
lines.en: It was lively and fun, but on the other hand there were many hardships too, weren't there, dear.
lines.style: Tender, knowing tone with a slight smile in the voice.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: そうだな。父が倒れた後、家計は著しく苦しくなってね。
lines.en: That's right. After father collapsed, our household finances became remarkably tough.
lines.style: Lower register, somber recollection, weight of past burdens audible.

lines.speaker: naoko_aunt
lines.jp: 貯金も僅かしか残っていなかったのに、よく乗り越えたわよね。
lines.en: Even though only a little savings remained, you really pulled through, didn't you.
lines.style: Gentle empathetic voice, quiet admiration coloring each word.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: 父が遺した条件を一つずつ満たすのに、必死だったよ。
lines.en: I was desperate just to fulfill the conditions father left behind, one by one.
lines.style: Quiet, sincere, an old man's heartfelt acknowledgment of past effort.

lines.speaker: naoko_aunt
lines.jp: ふふ、お互い様よ。さあ、お茶をもう一杯いれましょうか。
lines.en: Hehe, it goes both ways. Now then, shall I pour another cup of tea?
lines.style: Light laughter, gentle closing warmth, inviting and homely cadence.
